description: This Java class 'CommonEvents' provides various utility methods for handling user session settings (locale, timezone, theme, currency), generating CAPTCHA images, loading JWT tokens, opening source files for debugging, and responding with JavaScript or JSON data within a web application context. It is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.common' package and includes external library references, utility method calls, and class definitions relevant to web services and user session management.

classes.name: CommonEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing web service endpoints for session management, CAPTCHA generation, JWT handling, and source code viewing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setSessionLocale
methods.description: Sets the user's session locale based on request parameter and updates the user login cache.

methods.name: setSessionTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the user's session time zone based on request parameter and updates the user login cache.

methods.name: setSessionTheme
methods.description: Sets the user's session visual theme based on request parameter.

methods.name: setSessionCurrencyUom
methods.description: Sets the user's session currency unit of measure and updates the user login cache.

methods.name: jsResponseFromRequest
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript response based on a script cached for the session.

methods.name: jsonResponseFromRequestAttributes
methods.description: Returns a JSON response constructed from request attributes, excluding certain internal attributes.

methods.name: writeJSONtoResponse
methods.description: Helper method to write JSON data to HTTP response with proper headers.

methods.name: getCaptcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image, stores the code in session, and writes the image to the response.

methods.name: loadJWT
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for the secured user login ID and responds with JSON.

methods.name: openSourceFile
methods.description: Opens a source file in an external editor or viewer based on configuration, for debugging purposes.
